| 311–359 | Tracer advection scheme / 알고리즘·조건 — 추적자별 스위치와 양의 장·온도에 대한 알고리즘 선택 설명, 알고리즘 목록·축약 규칙을 적는다(315–338). HSIMT 또는 MPDATA에서 단조성(monotonicity)을 보존하려면 수평·수직에 같은 기법을 설정해야 한다는 조건과 각 키워드의 차원을 적는다(340–358). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (311); `! Tracer advection scheme.` (312); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (313); `! It is more advantageous to set the horizontal and vertical advection schemes` (315); `! for each tracer with switches instead of a single CPP flag for all of them.` (316); `! Positive-definite and monotonic algorithms (i.e., MPDATA and HSIMT) are` (317); `! appropriate and useful for positive fields like salinity, inert, biological,` (318); `! and sediment tracers.  However, since the temperature has a dynamic range` (319); `! with negative and positive values in the ocean, other advection schemes are` (320); `! more appropriate.` (321); `! Currently, the following tracer advection schemes are available and are` (323); `! activated using the associated Keyword:` (324); `!   Keyword    Advection Algorithm` (326); `!   A4         4th-order Akima (horizontal/vertical)` (328); `!   C2         2nd-order centered differences (horizontal/vertical)` (329); `!   C4         4th-order centered differences (horizontal/vertical)` (330); `!   HSIMT      3th-order HSIMT with TVD limiter (horizontal/vertical)` (331); `!   MPDATA     recursive flux corrected MPDATA (horizontal/vertical)` (332); `!   SPLINES    parabolic splines reconstruction (only vertical)` (333); `!   SU3        split third-order upstream (horizontal/vertical)` (334); `!   U3         3rd-order upstresm-bias (only horizontal)` (335); `! The user has the option of specifying the full Keyword or the first` (337); `! two letters, regardless if using uppercase or lowercase.` (338); `! If using either HSIMT (Wu and Zhu, 2010) or MPDATA (Margolin and` (340); `! Smolarkiewicz, 1998) options, the user needs to set the same scheme` (341); `! for both horizontal and vertical advection to preserve monotonicity.` (342); `! Hadvection     Horizontal advection for each active (temperature and` (344); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids]` (345); `!                  values are expected.` (346); `! Vadvection     Vertical advection for each active (temperature and` (348); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids]` (349); `!                  values are expected.` (350); `! ad_Hadvection  Horizontal advection for each active (temperature and` (352); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers in the adjoint-based` (353); `!                  algorithms, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids] values are expected.` (354); `! ad_Vadvection  Vertical advection for each active (temperature and` (356); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers in the adjoint-based` (357); `!                  algorithms, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids] values are expected.` (358). |
| 360–397 | Tracer advection scheme / 입력 예시 — 온도·염분·비활성 추적자(inert tracers)의 이어쓰기 예시와 격자별 이류 기법 예시를 적는다(360–386). 모든 수동 추적자(passive tracers)의 수평·수직 기법이 같을 때 쓰는 축약 입력 예시를 적는다(388–396). 원문: `! Examples:` (360); `!  Hadvection == A4       \                     ! temperature` (362); `!                MPDATA   \                     ! salinity` (363); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! dye_01, inert(1)` (364); `!                HSIMT                          ! dy2_02, inert(2)` (365); `!  Vadvection == A4       \                     ! temperature` (367); `!                MPDATA   \                     ! salinity` (368); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! dye_01, inert(1)` (369); `!                HSIMT                          ! dye_02, inert(2)` (370); `! or in nested applications` (372); `!  Hadvection == U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 1` (374); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 1` (375); `!                U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 2` (376); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 2` (377); `!                U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 3` (378); `!                HSIMT                          ! salinity,    Grid 3` (379); `!  Vadvection == C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 1` (381); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 1` (382); `!                C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 2` (383); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 2` (384); `!                C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 3` (385); `!                HSIMT                          ! salinity,    Grid 3` (386); `! It is convinient to use the compact specification format for biological and` (388); `! sediment passive tracers as:` (389); `!  Hadvection == HSIMT                          ! idbio(:), compact` (391); `!  Vadvection == HSIMT                          ! idbio(:), compact` (393); `! when all the passive tracers have the same horizontal and vertical tracer` (395); `! advection scheme.` (396). |
| 398–422 | Lateral boundary conditions parameters / 구조·키워드 — 논리 스위치와 LBC 구조 배열의 차원을 적는다(402–409). 각 방향의 gradient 구성 예시, 대소문자 규칙과 RadNud 복합 조건을 적는다(410–421). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (398); `! Lateral boundary conditions parameters.` (399); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (400); `! The lateral boundary conditions are now specified with logical switches` (402); `! instead of CPP flags to allow nested grid configurations. Their values are` (403); `! load into structured array:` (404); `!    LBC(1:4, nLBCvar, Ngrids)` (406); `! where 1:4 are the number of boundary edges, nLBCvar are the number LBC state` (408); `! variables, and Ngrids is the number of nested grids. For Example, to apply` (409); `! gradient boundary conditions to any tracer we use:` (410); `!    LBC(iwest,  isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (412); `!    LBC(ieast,  isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (413); `!    LBC(isouth, isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (414); `!    LBC(inorth, isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (415); `! The lateral boundary conditions for biological tracers are entered with` (417); `! a keyword. This keyword is case insensitive and usually has three characters.` (418); `! However, it is possible to have compound keywords, if applicable. For example,` (419); `! the keyword "RadNud" implies radiation boundary condition with nudging. This` (420); `! combination is usually used in active/passive radiation conditions.` (421). |
| 423–458 | Lateral boundary conditions / 축약 예시·도식 — 생물 추적자 전체에 한 경계 조건 항목을 적용하는 입력 예시를 원문대로 옮긴다(423–439). 경계 유형 문자 도식은 북·남·서·동을 4·2·1·3으로 배치한다(441–450). 비선형·수반 기반 키워드의 차원을 적는다(452–457). 원문: `! It is possible to specify the lateral boundary conditions for all biological` (423); `! tracers in a compact form with a single entry.  for example, in a East-West` (424); `! periodic application we can just have:` (425); `!                   W       S       E       N` (427); `!                   e       o       a       o` (428); `!                   s       u       s       r` (429); `!                   t       t       t       t` (430); `!                           h               h` (431); `!                   1       2       3       4` (433); `!  LBC(isTvar) ==   Gra     Gra     Gra     Clo` (435); `! Then, the standard input processing routine will assume that all the` (437); `! biological tracers have the same lateral boundary condition specified by` (438); `! the single entry.` (439); `!   Keyword    Lateral Boundary Condition Type` (441); `!   Cla        Clamped                                _____N_____     j=Mm` (443); `!   Clo        Closed                                \|     4     \|` (444); `!   Gra        Gradient                              \|           \|` (445); `!   Nes        Nested                              1 W           E 3` (446); `!   Nud        Nudging                               \|           \|` (447); `!   Per        Periodic                              \|_____S_____\|` (448); `!   Rad        Radiation                                   2          j=1` (449); `!                                                   i=1         i=Lm` (450); `!  LBC(isTvar)    Biological Tracers, [1:4, 1:NBT, Ngrids] values are expected.` (452); `! Similarly, the adjoint-based algorithms (ADM, TLM, RPM) can have different` (454); `! lateral boundary conditions keywords:` (455); `!  ad_LBC(isTvar) Biological Tracers, [1:4, 1:NBT, Ngrids] values are expected.` (457). |
| 459–500 | Tracer point Sources/Sink sources switches — LtracerSrc의 차원과 추적자 예시를 적는다(460–466). 모든 하천의 온도·염분 지정 의무와 다른 추적자의 선택성, river_flag를 대체하는 스위치·이전 NetCDF 속성 예시·이전 형식 호환(backward compatibility)을 적는다(468–489). 공급이 없는 하천도 해당 추적자의 0 값을 지정해야 한다는 조건을 적는다(491–499). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (459); `!  Tracer point Sources/Sink sources switches: [1:NBT,1:Ngrids].` (460); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (461); `!  LtracerSrc     Logical switches (T/F) to activate biological tracer` (463); `!                   variables point Sources/Sinks.` (464); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio(1),ng)     Dinoflagellate concetration` (466); `!                   Recall that these switches are usually activated to add` (468); `!                   river runoff as a point source. At minimum, it is necessary` (469); `!                   to specify both temperature and salinity for all rivers.` (470); `!                   The other tracers are optional. The user needs to know the` (471); `!                   correspondence between biological variables and indices` (472); `!                   idbio(1:NBT) when activating one or more of these switches.` (473); `!                   These logical switches REPLACES and ELIMINATES the need to` (475); `!                   have or read the variable "river_flag(river)" in the input` (476); `!                   rivers forcing NetCDF file:` (477); `!                     double river_flag(river)` (479); `!                        river_flag:long_name = "river runoff tracer flag"` (480); `!                        river_flag:option_0 = "all tracers are off"` (481); `!                        river_flag:option_1 = "only temperature"` (482); `!                        river_flag:option_2 = "only salinity"` (483); `!                        river_flag:option_3 = "both temperature and salinity"` (484); `!                        river_flag:units = "nondimensional"` (485); `!                   This logic was too cumbersome and complicated when` (487); `!                   additional tracers are considered. However, this change` (488); `!                   is backward compatible.` (489); `!                   The LtracerSrc switch will be used to activate the reading` (491); `!                   of respective tracer variable from input river forcing` (492); `!                   NetCDF file. If you want to add other tracer variables` (493); `!                   (other than temperature and salinity) as a source for a` (494); `!                   particular river(s), you just need to specify such values` (495); `!                   on those river(s). Then, set the values to ZERO on the` (496); `!                   other river(s) that do NOT require such river forcing for` (497); `!                   that tracer. Recall that you need to specify the tracer` (498); `!                   values for all rivers, even if their values are zero.` (499). |
| 501–516 | Tracer climatology processing switches — LtracerCLM의 차원·추적자 예시와 TCLIMATOLOGY 대체를 적는다(502–511). 기후장의 수평 혼합·완충 영역·뉴징 용도 및 필요한 장만 처리해 메모리 할당을 줄일 수 있다는 설명을 적는다(505–515). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (501); `!  Tracer climatology processing switches: [1:NBT,1:Ngrids].` (502); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (503); `!  LtracerCLM     Logical switches (T/F) to process biological tracer variables` (505); `!                   climatology.  The CPP option TCLIMATOLOGY is now obsolete` (506); `!                   and replaced with these switches to facilitate nesting` (507); `!                   applications. Currently, the CLIMA(ng)%tclm is used for` (508); `!                   horizontal mixing, sponges, and nudging.` (509); `!                     LtracerCLM(idbio(1),ng)     Dinoflagellate concetration` (511); `!                   These switches also controls which climatology tracer` (513); `!                   fields needs to be processed.  So we may reduce the` (514); `!                   memory allocation for the CLIMA(ng)%tclm array.` (515). |
| 517–539 | Logical switches for nudging to climatology — LnudgeTCLM의 차원·추적자 예시와 TCLM_NUDGING 대체를 적는다(518–527). 필요한 LtracerCLM 활성화, ANA_TCLIMA 또는 NetCDF 기후장 설정, ANA_NUDGCOEF 또는 NUDNAME 계수 입력 조건을 적는다(529–538). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (517); `!  Logical switches for nudging to climatology: [1:NBT,1:Ngrids].` (518); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (519); `!  LnudgeTCLM     Logical switches (T/F) to activate the nugding of biological` (521); `!                   tracer variables climatology. These switches also control` (522); `!                   which biological tracer variables to nudge. The CPP option` (523); `!                   TCLM_NUDGING is now obsolete and replaced with these` (524); `!                   switches to facilitate nesting.` (525); `!                     LnudgeTCLM(idbio(1),ng)     Dinoflagellate concetration` (527); `!                   User also needs to TURN ON the respective logical switches` (529); `!                   "LtracerCLM", described above, to process the required 3D` (530); `!                   biological tracer climatology data. This data can be set` (531); `!                   with analytical functions (ANA_TCLIMA) or read from input` (532); `!                   climatology NetCDF file(s).` (533); `!                   The nudging coefficients CLIMA(ng)%Tnudgcof can be set` (535); `!                   with analytical functions in "ana_nudgcoef.h"  using CPP` (536); `!                   option ANA_NUDGCOEF.  Otherwise, it will be read from` (537); `!                   NetCDF file NUDNAME.` (538). |

## 판독 중 확인된 사실 (판단 아님, 후속 검토 대상)

- 1·224–227: 파일 제목은 `Hypoxia Simple Respiration Model Biological Parameters.`이다. 용어집 제목은 `Red Tide (Stock et al., 2005; He et al., 2008) Biological Model Parameters.`이다. 용어집은 생물 추적자를 `oxygen` 한 개로 적는다.
- 64–68·275–283: `LtracerSponge`의 기대값 차원은 설정 앞 주석에서 `[Ngrids]`, 용어집에서 `[1:NBT,1:Ngrids]`이다.
- 227·466·511·527·552·567: 생물 추적자 목록은 `idbio(1)`을 `oxygen`으로 적는다. 점 공급·기후장·뉴징 예시와 HISTORY·QUICKSAVE 인덱스 설명은 같은 추적자를 `Dinoflagellate`로 적고, 출력 인덱스에는 `iDino`를 쓴다.
- 423–435·443–449: 경계 입력 예시는 `a East-West periodic application`이라고 소개한다. 실제 예시는 `LBC(isTvar) ==   Gra     Gra     Gra     Clo`이다. 같은 표는 `Gra`를 `Gradient`, `Per`를 `Periodic`으로 정의한다.
